"Game Title: Bharat Logistics: Highway Tycoon @COMMENT_BODY@ Simulator

Genre: Hyper-Realistic Open-World Vehicle, Business @COMMENT_BODY@ Life Simulator
Target Platform: Android, iOS @COMMENT_BODY@ PC

1. Core Concept @COMMENT_BODY@ Vision

Bharat Logistics is a hyper-realistic, visually stunning simulation game where players experience the real-life journey of starting from a single second-hand pickup truck and building a massive pan-India transport and logistics empire.
Designed to be instantly appealing and highly shareable on YouTube and social media, the game combines photorealistic graphics, authentic Indian roads, deep vehicle physics, and satisfying business management. Every trip feels alive, unpredictable, and cinematic.

2. Why Everyone Will Love @COMMENT_BODY@ Share It (Viral Appeal)

• Ultra-Realistic Visuals @COMMENT_BODY@ Lighting: Built with dynamic ray-traced style reflections, volumetric fog, golden hour sunsets, and realistic monsoon rain puddles that splash onto the windshield.
• Authentic Desi Atmosphere: Drive past bustling highway dhabas, colorful painted trucks with classic slogans (\"Horn OK Please\"), toll plazas, street markets, and iconic landmarks.
• Cinematic Photo @COMMENT_BODY@ Drone Mode: Players can pause at any scenic location—like a foggy mountain pass in Manali or a coastal bridge in Mumbai—and use a free-flying camera with filters to take viral screenshots and short clips.
• Custom Horn @COMMENT_BODY@ Music System: Customize multi-tone musical air horns and play local radio stations or custom MP3 tracks while cruising down the highway.

3. Detailed Gameplay Mechanics


A. Realistic Driving @COMMENT_BODY@ Vehicle Physics

• True-to-Life Handling: Every vehicle has realistic weight distribution, suspension bounce, braking distance, and tire grip. Overloading your truck makes uphill climbs challenging and requires careful gear shifting.
• Interactive Cockpit View: Full first-person interior view where you physically turn the ignition key, toggle windshield wipers, adjust side mirrors, use dipper lights at night, and check dashboard fuel/temperature gauges.
• Dynamic Weather @COMMENT_BODY@ Road Conditions: Experience slippery monsoon mudslides, dense winter fog with low visibility, and scorching summer heat where engines can overheat if pushed too hard.

B. Progression: From Local Driver to Transport Tycoon

• Phase 1 (Rookie Driver): Start in a small town with a basic mini-truck (like a Tata Ace style pickup). Deliver local goods—vegetables, milk cans, furniture, and construction bricks—through narrow, crowded streets.
• Phase 2 (Highway Hauler): Save money to buy heavy 6-wheeler, 10-wheeler, and 18-wheeler container trucks. Take long-distance contracts across states, transporting heavy machinery, cars, fuel tankers, and fragile electronics.
• Phase 3 (Logistics Empire): Buy garages across major cities, hire AI drivers, purchase a fleet of trucks, manage fuel costs, and monitor real-time profits on an in-game tablet.

C. Life Simulation @COMMENT_BODY@ Survival Elements

• Highway Dhaba Stops: Your driver gets hungry and sleepy. Stop at illuminated roadside dhabas at night to eat hot meals, drink tea, rest, and chat with other drivers for secret high-paying cargo tips.
• Vehicle Maintenance @COMMENT_BODY@ Fuel: Check tire pressure, engine oil, and brake pads. If you ignore maintenance, your tire might burst mid-highway, forcing you to call a tow truck or change the spare wheel yourself.

4. Deep Vehicle Customization (Garage Mode)

Players can spend hours customizing their vehicles and sharing builds online:
• Exterior Art: Traditional Indian truck art, custom neon underglow, chrome bullbars, mudflaps, flags, and rooftop carrier lights.
• Performance Upgrades: Turbochargers, heavy-duty suspension, off-road tires, and larger fuel tanks.
• Interior Decor: Dashboard idols, hanging garlands, velvet seat covers, and custom LED cabin lights.

5. Diverse Map @COMMENT_BODY@ Iconic Routes

A massive, seamless open-world map featuring distinct regions:
• The Western Ghats @COMMENT_BODY@ Mumbai-Pune Expressway: Winding mountain roads, tunnels, and heavy monsoon waterfalls.
• The Thar

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
